name: Knowledge Work Router
description: Capability router for knowledge-work packs. Discovers available services dynamically through adapters (Composio, native tools, Lobster, CLI, MCPorter) with automatic fallback and onboarding.

adapterOrder.description: Global adapter fallback order for capability probing

capabilityPins.description: Pin capabilities to specific adapters (e.g. seo.*: mcporter)

sideEffectPolicy.description: When to require confirmation before side-effecting actions

cacheTtl.description: Discovery cache TTL in milliseconds (default 10 minutes)

cliMappings.description: Map capability patterns to CLI binaries (e.g. docs.convert_*: pandoc)
